caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a fish-shaped carving, rendered in shades of light brown and gray with subtle pencil or watercolor textures. The fish has a distinct oval body with a textured, serrated dorsal and ventral edge, a carved pectoral fin on its side, and a simple tail fin with visible grooves. There is a round black dot representing the eye and a small curved line indicating the mouth. Near the front of the fish, a rectangular, vertically-oriented wooden piece is attached underneath the body, and a thin vertical rod protrudes from the fish's upper surface just behind the head. The background is empty and uniform, light beige in color, drawing all attention to the fish-shaped object in the center of the composition.
title: Fish Weather Vane
